subject: Import AI 482: Huawei kernel benchmarks; airborne drone detection; and a national lab's AI science benchmark
notes: Research-paper issue (AscendGYM, SciResearch-Eval, A2A-UAV datasets/benchmarks) plus fiction; the only deal or market event reported is the Noeri raise.

stories.headline: Noeri, a neolab launched by Stanford professors Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin, has raised $110m
stories.quote: Stanford profs Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin have launched Noeri, “a neolab to push the frontier of plural intelligence”. They have raised $110m and are relatively light on technical details
stories.description: Neolab building many small, specialized, continually learning AI models
stories.founder_background: Stanford professors Yejin Choi and Carlos Guestrin
